title: Minimum Swaps to Make Strings Equal
goal: Find the fewest cross-string swaps needed to make two x/y strings equal.
strategy: Same-direction mismatches pair in one swap. Two leftover opposite directions require two swaps; an odd total number of mismatches is impossible.
